# Counting missing proteome

## v.24 - Missing proteome

```{r}
v24_missing <- hpa_data_v24 |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` == "No human protein/transcript evidence")

nrow(v24_missing)
```

## v.25 - Added through cell type and cell line data

```{r}
v25_missing <- hpa_data_v25 |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` == "No human protein/transcript evidence")

nrow(v25_missing)


v_24_v_25_missing <- v25_missing |>
  filter(Ensembl %in% v24_missing$Ensembl)

# Genes which have evidence in v.24 but not in v.25
v25_missing |>
  setdiff(v_24_v_25_missing) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24, by = "Ensembl")
```

## Orthologs

### More strict

```{r}
# How many genes have at least one _ortho = 1?
missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(ortholog_data, by = c("Ensembl" = "Gene.stable.ID")) |>
  select(Ensembl,
         macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho) |>
  filter(macaque_ortho + mouse_ortho + rat_ortho + pig_ortho > 0) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  nrow()

strict_ortho <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(ortholog_data, by = c("Ensembl" = "Gene.stable.ID")) |>
  select(Ensembl,
         macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) 

# 1) Join and extract the 4 binary ortholog columns
ortholog_flags <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(ortholog_data, by = c("Ensembl" = "Gene.stable.ID")) |>
  select(Ensembl,
         macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  # treat NA as 0, ensure logical TRUE/FALSE for eulerr
  mutate(across(c(macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho),
                ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0))) |>
  mutate(across(-Ensembl, ~ . > 0))

# 2) Fit Euler diagram (rows = elements, columns = sets of logicals)
fit <- eulerr::euler(ortholog_flags |>
                       select(-Ensembl),
                     shape = "ellipse")  # ellipse is robust for 4 sets

# 3) Plot
pal <- c("macaque_ortho" = "#66c2a5",
         "mouse_ortho"   = "#fc8d62",
         "rat_ortho"     = "#8da0cb",
         "pig_ortho"     = "#e78ac3")

p_ortho <- plot(
  fit,
  fills      = list(fill = unname(pal), alpha = 0.8),
  edges      = list(col = "grey20", lwd = 1),
  labels     = list(labels = c("Macaque", "Mouse", "Rat", "Pig"),
                    col = "black", fontsize = 12, font = 2),
  quantities = list(type = "counts", fontsize = 10, font = 2),
  legend     = FALSE
)

p_ortho  # display

# 4) Save (convert to ggplot object for ggsave)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 4/orthologs_eulerr.png", ggplotify::as.ggplot(p), width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 4/orthologs_eulerr.pdf", ggplotify::as.ggplot(p), width = 6, height = 5)
```

### Low - confidence orthologs

```{r}
low_conf_orthologs <- ortholog_data |>
  # If for example macaque_identity is 0 then macaque_low is TRUE, otherwise FALSE
  mutate(macaque_low = ifelse(macaque_ortho == 0, 1, 0)) |>
  mutate(mouse_low   = ifelse(mouse_ortho   == 0, 1, 0)) |>
  mutate(rat_low     = ifelse(rat_ortho     == 0, 1, 0)) |>
  mutate(pig_low     = ifelse(pig_ortho     == 0, 1, 0)) |>
  select(Ensembl = Gene.stable.ID,
         macaque_low, mouse_low, rat_low, pig_low)




# Convert 0/1 into logical TRUE/FALSE
venn_data <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(low_conf_orthologs, by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(across(c(macaque_low, mouse_low, rat_low, pig_low), ~ . == 1))

# Fit the Euler diagram
fit <- euler(
  venn_data %>% select(macaque_low, mouse_low, rat_low, pig_low),
  shape = "ellipse"
)

# Color palette
pal <- c("macaque_low" = "#66c2a5",
         "mouse_low"   = "#fc8d62",
         "rat_low"     = "#8da0cb",
         "pig_low"     = "#e78ac3")

# Plot
p <- plot(
  fit,
  fills      = list(fill = unname(pal), alpha = 0.7),
  edges      = list(col = "grey30"),
  labels     = list(labels = c("Macaque low", "Mouse low", "Rat low", "Pig low"),
                    col = "black", fontsize = 12, font = 2),
  quantities = list(type = "counts", fontsize = 10, font = 2),
  legend     = FALSE
)

p  # show

# Save
ggsave("..plots/venn_low_conf_orthologs.png", as.ggplot(p), width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("..plots/venn_low_conf_orthologs.pdf", as.ggplot(p), width = 6, height = 5)
```

### More generous

```{r}
generous_ortho <- ortholog_data |>
  # If a gene has _ortho as 0, then if _identity is > 0, then _ortho should be set to 1.
  mutate(macaque_ortho = ifelse(macaque_ortho == 0 & macaque_identity > 0, 1, macaque_ortho)) |>
  mutate(mouse_ortho   = ifelse(mouse_ortho   == 0 & mouse_identity   > 0, 1, mouse_ortho)) |>
  mutate(rat_ortho     = ifelse(rat_ortho     == 0 & rat_identity     > 0, 1, rat_ortho)) |>
  mutate(pig_ortho     = ifelse(pig_ortho     == 0 & pig_identity     > 0, 1, pig_ortho)) |>
  select(Ensembl = Gene.stable.ID,
         macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Convert 0/1 into logical TRUE/FALSE
venn_data <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(generous_ortho, by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(across(c(macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho), ~ . == 1))

generous_ortho <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(generous_ortho, by = "Ensembl") |>
  select(Ensembl,
         macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Fit the Euler diagram
fit <- euler(
  venn_data %>% select(macaque_ortho, mouse_ortho, rat_ortho, pig_ortho),
  shape = "ellipse"
)

# Color palette
pal <- c("macaque_ortho" = "#66c2a5",
         "mouse_ortho"   = "#fc8d62",
         "rat_ortho"     = "#8da0cb",
         "pig_ortho"     = "#e78ac3")

# Plot
p_generous <- plot(
  fit,
  fills      = list(fill = unname(pal), alpha = 0.7),
  edges      = list(col = "grey30"),
  labels     = list(labels = c("Macaque ortho", "Mouse ortho", "Rat ortho", "Pig ortho"),
                    col = "black", fontsize = 12, font = 2),
  quantities = list(type = "counts", fontsize = 10, font = 2),
  legend     = FALSE
)

p_generous  # show
```

```{r}
as.ggplot(p_ortho) + labs(title = "Strict orthologs") +
```

```{r}
# Example: suppose you have counts already (replace with your logic to compute them)
# strict_ortho and generous_ortho are logical 0/1 columns for each species
counts <- ortholog_data %>%
  summarise(
    Macaque_strict   = sum(macaque_ortho == 1),
    Macaque_generous = n(),  # replace with real condition
    Mouse_strict     = sum(mouse_ortho == 1),
    Mouse_generous   = n(),
    Rat_strict       = sum(rat_ortho == 1),
    Rat_generous     = n(),
    Pig_strict       = sum(pig_ortho == 1),
    Pig_generous     = n()
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = c("Species", "Category"),
               names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("strict", "generous")),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Macaque", "Mouse", "Rat", "Pig"))
  )

# Plot: grouped bars by species
ggplot(counts, aes(x = Species, y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("strict" = "#1b9e77", "generous" = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(
    title = "Ortholog counts per species",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes",
    fill = "Ortholog type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Helper: count positives per species in a given table
count_orthos <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%                 # avoid double-counting
    select(matches("^(macaque|mouse|rat|pig)_ortho$")) %>%  # the 4 species columns
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(. == 1, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Species_raw", values_to = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Species = recode(Species_raw,
                       macaque_ortho = "Macaque",
                       mouse_ortho   = "Mouse",
                       rat_ortho     = "Rat",
                       pig_ortho     = "Pig")
    ) %>%
    select(Species, Count)
}

# Build count tables from each source
strict_counts   <- count_orthos(strict_ortho)   %>% mutate(Category = "strict_ortho")
generous_counts <- count_orthos(generous_ortho) %>% mutate(Category = "generous_ortho")

# Combine for plotting; enforce ordering so "strict" is left of "generous"
plot_df <- bind_rows(strict_counts, generous_counts) %>%
  mutate(
    Species  = factor(Species,  levels = c("Macaque", "Mouse", "Rat", "Pig")),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("strict_ortho", "generous_ortho"))
  )

# Colors
cat_cols <- c("strict_ortho" = "#1b9e77", "generous_ortho" = "#d95f02")

# Plot: two bars per species (strict first, generous second)
p_ortho_counts <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Species, y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cat_cols, name = "Ortholog set") +
  labs(
    title = "Ortholog counts per species",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_ortho_counts

# Optional labels above each bar:
p_ortho_counts +
   geom_text(aes(label = Count),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
             vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
   coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(plot_df$Count) * 1.12))
```

## GO terms

```{r}
make_treemap_save <- function(df, column, 
                              max_categories = 50, 
                              title = "Treemap",
                              file_prefix = "treemap",
                              out_dir = "") {
  # Prepare counts (split, flatten, count)
  items <- df %>%
    dplyr::pull({{ column }}) %>%
    stringr::str_split(", ") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    .[. != ""]
  tab <- as.data.frame(table(items))
  tab <- tab %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(Freq)) %>% head(max_categories)
  
  # Set up filename
  file_base <- paste0(out_dir, file_prefix, "_", gsub(" ", "_", title))
  png_file <- paste0(file_base, ".png")
  pdf_file <- paste0(file_base, ".pdf")
  
  # PNG
  png(png_file, width = 1200, height = 900, res = 120)
  treemap(tab,
          index = "items",
          vSize = "Freq",
          title = title,
          fontsize.title = 20,
          fontsize.labels = 16,
          align.labels = list(c("center", "center")),
          border.col = "white",
          palette = "Set2")
  dev.off()
  # PDF
  pdf(pdf_file, width = 12, height = 9)
  treemap(tab,
          index = "items",
          vSize = "Freq",
          title = title,
          fontsize.title = 20,
          fontsize.labels = 16,
          align.labels = list(c("center", "center")),
          border.col = "white",
          palette = "Set2")
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", png_file, "and", pdf_file, "\n")
}
```

## Relation between GO terms and orthologous genes

```{r}
missing_proteome_with_go_orthologs <- missing_proteome |>
  mutate(has_go = if_else(Ensembl %in% missing_proteome_with_go$Ensembl, "Yes", "No")) |>
  mutate(has_ortho = if_else(Ensembl %in% ortholog_flags$Ensembl, "Yes", "No")) |>
  mutate(is_missing = "Yes") |>
  select(Ensembl, has_go, has_ortho, is_missing)
  
# 1) Convert Yes/No to logical TRUE/FALSE
venn_data <- missing_proteome_with_go_orthologs %>%
  mutate(across(c(has_go, has_ortho, is_missing), ~ . == "Yes"))

# 2) Fit Euler diagram
fit <- euler(venn_data %>% select(has_go, has_ortho, is_missing),
             shape = "ellipse")

  fills      = list(fill = unname(pal), alpha = 0.7),
```

## Upset orthologs

```{r}
ortholog_flags <- missing_proteome |>
  inner_join(ortholog_data, by = c("Ensembl" = "Gene.stable.ID")) |>
  select(Ensembl,
         macaque_types, mouse_types, rat_types, pig_types) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) 


rna_datasets <- c("Tissue", "Brain", "Cell type", "Immune cell type", "Cell line")

evidence_only <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% rna_datasets)

upset_data <- evidence_only %>%
  mutate(set_name = Evidence_type) %>%
  select(Ensembl, set_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = set_name, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

set_order <- c("Tissue evidence", "Brain evidence", "Cell type evidence", "Immune cell type evidence", "Cell line evidence")
set_order <- rev(set_order)
upset_data <- upset_data[, c("Ensembl", set_order)]

upset_data$overlap_count <- rowSums(upset_data[, set_order])

upset_long <- upset_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, overlap_count, all_of(set_order)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(set_order), names_to = "set", values_to = "present") %>%
  filter(present == 1) 


fig2a <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  data = upset_data,
  intersect   = set_order,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Number of genes' = intersection_size(
      text = list(
        size     = 4,
        vjust    = -0.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        color    = "black"
      )
    )
  ),
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 4,
        color = "white",
        fontface = "bold"
      ) 
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over"
)

fig2a
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Expand each species into three binary sets
upset_data <- ortholog_flags %>%
  transmute(
    Ensembl,
    Macaque_one2one    = ifelse(macaque_types == "ortholog_one2one",    1, 0),
    Macaque_one2many   = ifelse(macaque_types == "ortholog_one2many",   1, 0),
    Macaque_many2many  = ifelse(macaque_types == "ortholog_many2many",  1, 0),
    
    Mouse_one2one      = ifelse(mouse_types   == "ortholog_one2one",    1, 0),
    Mouse_one2many     = ifelse(mouse_types   == "ortholog_one2many",   1, 0),
    Mouse_many2many    = ifelse(mouse_types   == "ortholog_many2many",  1, 0),
    
    Rat_one2one        = ifelse(rat_types     == "ortholog_one2one",    1, 0),
    Rat_one2many       = ifelse(rat_types     == "ortholog_one2many",   1, 0),
    Rat_many2many      = ifelse(rat_types     == "ortholog_many2many",  1, 0),
    
    Pig_one2one        = ifelse(pig_types     == "ortholog_one2one",    1, 0),
    Pig_one2many       = ifelse(pig_types     == "ortholog_one2many",   1, 0),
    Pig_many2many      = ifelse(pig_types     == "ortholog_many2many",  1, 0)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 2. Choose set order (grouped by species)
set_order <- c(
  "Macaque_one2one", "Macaque_one2many", "Macaque_many2many",
  "Mouse_one2one",   "Mouse_one2many",   "Mouse_many2many",
  "Rat_one2one",     "Rat_one2many",     "Rat_many2many",
  "Pig_one2one",     "Pig_one2many",     "Pig_many2many"
)

# 3. Add overlap counts
upset_data <- upset_data %>%
  mutate(overlap_count = rowSums(across(all_of(set_order))))

# 4. Plot upset diagram
fig_orthologs_types <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  data = upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Number of genes' = intersection_size(
      text = list(
        size     = 4,
        vjust    = -0.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        color    = "black"
      )
    )
  ),
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 3.5,
        color = "white",
        fontface = "bold"
      )
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over"
)

fig_orthologs_types

  # set NA to 0

  group_by(Ensembl) |>

  filter(total == 0)
```
